text: Your neighbor's dog has been barking every night at 3am for a week.
A colleague rescheduled your meeting for the fourth time without asking.
Someone cut in front of you in a long grocery line.
The restaurant brought you the wrong order and then argued about it.
Your roommate ate the leftovers you labeled with your name.
A customer service agent put you on hold for forty minutes and then disconnected.
A stranger left a shopping cart dented against your car door.
Your landlord ignored three requests to fix the heating.
A coworker presented your analysis in a meeting as their own.
The airline lost your luggage and offered a ten-dollar voucher.
Someone keeps replying-all to a company-wide email chain.
A driver honked at you the instant the light turned green.
Your contractor finished two weeks late and over budget.
A friend cancelled plans an hour before, again.
Your package was marked delivered but never arrived.
A reviewer rejected your paper without reading the methods section.
The person next to you on the train is playing videos without headphones.
Your manager asked for a report and then said they no longer need it.
A delivery driver threw your fragile package over the fence.
Someone parked across two spaces in a full lot.
Your internet provider raised the price without notice.
A relative criticized your cooking in front of everyone.
A software update deleted your saved settings.
A teammate missed a deadline and blamed you for it.
Your gym cancelled your class without telling anyone.
A stranger corrected your pronunciation in a condescending way.
The hotel gave away your reserved room.
A coworker microwaved fish in the shared office kitchen.
Your bank charged an overdraft fee caused by their own error.
Someone took the last parking spot you were clearly waiting for.
A salesperson ignored you to talk to their friend.
Your flight was delayed six hours with no explanation.
A neighbor's party kept you awake before an important exam.
A classmate copied your homework and got a better grade.
Your phone repair shop scratched the screen they were supposed to fix.
The city towed your car from a spot with no sign.
A guest spilled wine on your couch and didn't mention it.
Your coworker keeps scheduling meetings during your lunch hour.
A store refused to accept a return within the stated policy window.
Someone spoiled the ending of a show you were watching.
